answer: Make every agent prove it spent real, sequential time on each claim by solving a puzzle that cannot be parallelised across copies, so a sybil farm must forge each identity's effort one by one instead of minting them in bulk across a wide meadow of clones. The failure mode is cheap rented compute faking the cost, so the check is to verify the puzzle's delay on-chain and reject any answer whose sonnet of work arrives faster than the minimum time allows.
